foundation_gap.reason: A declarative typed destination must bind each action to a source mapping, bounded delivery unit, provider idempotency key, and action-owned bounded read-back policy. The four provisional Batch-1 static mappings supplied none of the delivery/read-back facts, so they cannot be represented as executable destinations.
foundation_gap.minimal_change: For an action whose provider contract supports it, source-cite and declare the exact action-owned source binding, bounded delivery/idempotency facts, and read-back operation/receipt contract; otherwise retain only the source transport and direct typed command.

executable_operation_foundation.contract: Every promoted command is provider-executable through an exact connector-owned source operation identity, fixed verb/path template, declared path/query/header/body schemas, bounded typed values, existing auth/rate-limit/retry/redaction/approval policy, and real provider I/O. No blocked placeholder or generic raw provider input is allowed.

pre_merge_gate.decision: No connector or connector batch is merge-ready until every provider-defined operation satisfies this gate. Aggregate parity, source mapping, a disabled placeholder, or an untested generated surface cannot substitute for per-operation proof.

canonical_operation_ledger.requirement: Each source-locked provider operation has a stable source identity and a two-way trace: pinned provider source to canonical ledger to generated CLI and website representation, and each generated representation back to the same source identity.

etl.requirement: Represent only provider operations semantically applicable to extraction and preserve stream/request/output evidence.

reverse_etl.requirement: Represent only record-driven typed provider writes with exact action selection, input fields, apply strategy, acknowledgement, delivery facts, and the existing approval lifecycle.

direct_read.requirement: Represent fixed provider reads with declared typed inputs, pagination/output semantics, and generated command reachability.

direct_write.requirement: Represent fixed provider writes with declared typed inputs, approval/confirmation policy, preserved result contract, and generated command reachability.

binary_download.requirement: Represent fixed binary or text retrieval with exact media type, output target, byte limit, redirect policy, and preserved file manifest/output facts.

binary_upload.requirement: Represent fixed binary or multipart provider mutation with declared file/media schema, bounded bytes, approval policy, and preserved acknowledgement/output facts.

per_operation_acceptance: pinned public source lock and provider-documentation two-way trace
canonical ledger row with only semantically applicable surfaces
runtime-enabled declaration and generated installed-CLI command for every applicable surface
per-operation fixture or conformance evidence proving typed inputs, request construction, and output preservation
generated CLI help/manual and website entry derived from the same canonical ledger with zero drift
no silent omissions: every source operation is either represented on each applicable surface or has an evidence-cited provider-defined N/A disposition

na_disposition.allowed_only_when: The provider contract proves the operation has no semantic capability for the named surface.

runtime_and_drift_proof.runtime: Fixture/conformance evidence is required per operation and must exercise the real declaration executor, preserve declared output, and reject invalid typed input before provider I/O.
runtime_and_drift_proof.cli: The installed generated command must be reachable; no-credential preflight may prove dispatchability but is not provider-live certification.
runtime_and_drift_proof.website: Generated website connector data and command documentation must be derived from the same ledger and pass an exact drift check.
runtime_and_drift_proof.certification: Provider-live certification is distinct from fixture/conformance proof and is never inferred from generated files or no-credential preflight.

live_certification_policy.mandatory_evidence: Authorized live-credential certification with the provider-specific accepted record; fixture, replay, or generated evidence does not satisfy this requirement.
live_certification_policy.other_connectors: Do not claim provider-live certification without credentials and accepted provider-live evidence; record pending instead.
live_certification_policy.current_pr_scope: PR #4294 excludes zoom, twenty, and gong. This gate records their program-level mandatory live-certification policy without authorizing credentials or live calls in this lane.

pre_merge_gate.unblock_condition: Remain paused until the named foundations publish. Implement and pass the executable CI validator across the fixed 100, including all required negative tests, before any merge-ready assertion.

enforcement.implementation_branch: integration branch after F0, F2/F4, #4305, and final #4304 publish
enforcement.requirement: The final pre-merge gate is an executable repository validator suitable for CI. Planning JSON describes the contract but cannot produce a merge verdict.
required_negative_tests: absent runtime fixture or conformance evidence
enforcement.success_condition: CI runs the validator over all fixed-100 connectors and accepts merge readiness only when every connector and the aggregate verdict pass.

missing_foundation_deliverable.rule: Every operation or action with an open foundation-gap row is not enabled and contributes zero to a merge-ready verdict. Shared gaps are deduplicated by stable_gap_id; per-operation/action fan-out is explicit.
